references.text: Jesus emphasizes the importance of being awake and prepared because one does not know when the Lord will come.
Similar to Jesus' warning to be prepared, because the Son of Man comes at an unexpected time.
Encourages not neglecting to meet together, especially as the day approaches, suggesting an expectation of the Lord's coming.
Paul speaks of the Lord's day coming like a thief in the night, which reflects Jesus' warning to be prepared.
